title: preleveldose: a diagnostic for mean reversion in designs dosed by baseline composition
description: Stata package implementing a reporting template for designs that dose units by a baseline composition and measure the outcome as a change in another summary of it: the bound on the mean-reversion channel relative to the coefficient, Fieller sets for ratios, the instrumented lever, and the distinction between own-level and proxy baseline controls. Version numbers converge to Galton's (1886) regression coefficient of two-thirds: 0.6, 0.66, 0.666.
